entries.zh: 革除；革人（撤去他人职任）
entries.en: to oust, to strip a person of rank; (detentar) to hold without right
entries.notes: L detentar（非法占据／扣留）与 H 革人（革职）语义方向相反，四栏未完全互证。

entries.en: to rid the people of a scourge; to remove a harm
entries.notes: L detentar 与汉义不合，疑词头误置或取其“祛除”引申；H 与 M 一致。

entries.zh: 流放；被判流徙（流徒＝流放刑徒）
entries.en: condemned to exile; detained and sentenced to banishment
entries.notes: 汉字作“流徒”，当即“流徙”（流放）之别写。

entries.zh: （身体）寒热失调；体内冷热不和
entries.en: distemper of the body; humoral imbalance of cold and heat
entries.notes: L 省作 Detemplança（destemplanza），指体液寒热失调。
R 栏有涂改且标 T99，依 H 断乳与 M tǔy-ny（斷乳）定夺。
M 栏末词 svaccer 疑为西／葡语旁注而非闽南语，H 滅、M bīn／bīẽ 可证。

entries.en: to destroy with fire and sword; to exterminate
to ruin, to corrupt, to lay waste

entries.zh: 击溃；打散（打却＝打退、击破）
entries.en: to shatter, to rout, to break up
entries.notes: H“打却”与闽南 pah-kiap（打劫）形近，然 L 为 desbaratar（击溃），取“打退、击破”义。

entries.en: to storm and breach a fortified city
to destroy by breaking; to smash
to ruin a household estate (through lawsuits)
